name: PodcastGuests.com

sources.title: Homepage — podcast guest matching service; free newsletter with 10 guest opportunities 2x/week, 47k+ users
Get Listed — Basic $15/mo annual ($20 monthly), Premium $33.25/mo annual ($45 monthly) expert directory profiles

conditions: Free path = the newsletter: sign up with name + email and receive 2 emails/week with ~10 podcasts seeking guests; apply via form to pitch yourself. The persistent expert-directory profile ('Get Listed') is paid-only
requirements: This lists PEOPLE as expert podcast guests, not products — you appear as a founder/expert with a 'one sheet' profile (bio, topics, 10 interview questions, photo, media appearances)
Newsletter join form is just Full Name + Email — free
Directory listing requires a paid plan: Basic ($15/mo billed annually, $20 monthly) or Premium ($33.25/mo annually, $45 monthly) with newsletter rotation and featured placement
preparation: Name and email for the free newsletter
For a paid profile: bio, list of topics you can discuss, 10 example interview questions, photo, social links, website link(s), list of previous media appearances
A guest pitch angle tied to your product/expertise
workflow: Free: fill the homepage join form → receive 2 emails/week listing podcasts seeking guests → apply via each listing's form (your email stays hidden)
Paid: go to https://podcastguests.com/join/ → pick Basic or Premium → register at /register/basic/ or /register/premium/ → build the one-sheet profile at /expert/<slug>
Podcasters contact you through the profile form
watchFor: Not a product directory — there is no product-listing surface; value is personal PR leading to podcast appearances
Annual pricing is the headline — monthly billing costs ~33% more
Premium members 'get significantly MORE invitations' per site copy — Basic visibility is weaker
countsAsLive: Free route: guest-opportunity emails arrive and your applications reach podcasters. Paid route: a public /expert/<slug> profile page exists in the guest directory
unknowns: Directory link is to your site but dofollow status unverified
Response rate of podcasters to applications
